Gaḍibhaṭṭa
lex. writer. Q. by Murārimiśra in his C. Ḍhaukā on Śabdaśabdārthamañjūṣā of Haṁvīramiśra. Adyar D.

Gaḍura
son of Caṇḍīdāsa (a. of a C. on the Kāvyaprakāśa); mentioned in Gaṇamārtaṇḍa, a C. by Caṇḍīdāsa's descendant Nṛsiṁha Tarkapañcānana on the Dhātupāṭha of Saṅkṣiptasāra; see IO. i. p. 226a.
